note: Series C (June 2023, $70M led by EQT Ventures) valued the company at $467M and brought total funding to ~$115M (Bloomberg/SiliconANGLE). In July 2026 Fly.io pivoted its messaging toward 'computers for agents' for AI workloads, raised a $25M Series D (Dell Technologies Capital + Intel Capital co-lead; a16z, EQT, Geodesic, YC participating), and brought on former Docker CEO Scott Johnston as CEO, with founder Kurt Mackey moving to an advisory board role. Fly reports >37,000 customers, >8,000 agent-native, with agent-native customers now ~two-thirds of revenue among its largest accounts. No confirmed current ARR/revenue figure has been publicly disclosed by the company itself.
